title: Split-count configuration construction
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $S$ and $H$ be types, and let $e:S\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\to H$ and $r:\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\to H$ be functions. For finite Boolean strings $w$ and $s$, and a configuration $c$ with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, state set $S$, and empty input, define $o$ to be the truth value of $|w|<|s|+|c.\mathrm{output}|$. The resulting configuration has $k+1$ work tapes, state set $H$, input $w$, state $e(q,o)$ if $c$ has state $q$ and $r(o)$ if $c$ has no state, input-head position given by the split-position construction for $w$ and $|s|+|c.\mathrm{output}|$, first work tape given by the buffer construction for $s$, remaining work tapes and their head positions inherited from $c$, new first work-tape head at $0$, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: configuration $c$ with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, state set $S$, and empty input
caveat: The supplied statement does not include definitions of the split-position and buffer constructions, so their exact mathematical meanings cannot be stated self-containedly.
